packageRules.description: The sentinel's RPM is tested on Rocky Linux 8.9 and 8.10 exactly (deploy/sentinel/tests/install.sh, 09/T8). Those minor releases are the targets, so a newer tag is a decision and not an update.

CloudNativePG moves as one: the operator image (tag and digest), the version and the manifest URL of deploy/tests/kind/pins.env. Renovate cannot compute LK_CNPG_MANIFEST_SHA256, and the CRDs vendored in deploy/schemas and the db chart README name the version too, so the update waits for a person to approve it on the dependency dashboard and then finish it.
prBodyNotes: Renovate moved the operator image, LK_CNPG_VERSION and LK_CNPG_MANIFEST_URL of deploy/tests/kind/pins.env. A person still has to: set LK_CNPG_MANIFEST_SHA256 to the sha256 of the new manifest (curl -fsSL "$LK_CNPG_MANIFEST_URL" | sha256sum; run.sh refuses a manifest whose hash differs); re-vendor the CRDs in deploy/schemas (their lock must agree); and update the version that deploy/charts/db/README.md names. .github/scripts/consistency.test.mjs fails until the README agrees.

packageRules.description: Contract paths change only through a contract-change PR that a human approves (AGENTS.md, Ownership): never merge by itself, and say so.

customManagers.description: The tool images that the scripts run, pinned by digest in deploy/images/tools.env, and the node image and the CloudNativePG operator image of the kind test in deploy/tests/kind/pins.env (tag and digest move together).
CloudNativePG's version in deploy/tests/kind/pins.env. Renovate sees a new release; the sha256 of its manifest and the vendored CRDs are a person's (see the packageRule for the operator).
The release manifest's URL names the version twice (the tag and the file), so the whole line is rebuilt.
